name: Algebraic Modulo Obfuscation
description: Replaced the separable quadratic energy function with the condition that $c_u^2 + c_u c_v + c_v^2$ must not be divisible by 3. By Fermat's Little Theorem, this is mathematically identical to $c_u \neq c_v$ for values in $\{1, 2, 3\}$, but it removes the obvious roots of the previous quadratic. This forces models to either algebraically deduce the equivalence or implement the constraint directly into a backtracking search, defeating those that rely on surface pattern matching to trigger a 3-coloring template.
